description: This file contains the implementation of the OCIContainerImplementation class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It manages OCI container lifecycle operations, event dispatching, and notification registration for container status updates. Functionality includes starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and retrieving container info, as well as handling container events.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Implements container lifecycle management, event notification, and external interface methods for OCI containers within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Core::hresult Register(Exchange::IOCIContainer::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for container events, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: Core::hresult Unregister(Exchange::IOCIContainer::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: void dispatchEvent(EventNames event,const JsonObject & params)
methods.description: Submits a container event to be processed asynchronously.

methods.name: void Dispatch(EventNames event,const JsonObject params)
methods.description: Dispatches container events to registered notifications based on event type and parameters.

methods.name: Core::hresult ListContainers(string & containers,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all containers.

methods.name: Core::hresult GetContainerInfo(const string & containerId,string & info,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: Core::hresult GetContainerState(const string & containerId,ContainerState & state,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: Core::hresult StartContainer(const string & containerId,const string & bundlePath,const string & command,const string & westerosSocket,int32_t & descriptor,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Starts a specified container with given parameters.

methods.name: Core::hresult StopContainer(const string & containerId,bool force,bool & success,string & errorReason)

methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: Core::hresult HibernateContainer(const string & containerId,const string & options,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Hibernates a container with options.

methods.name: Core::hresult WakeupContainer(const string & containerId,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: Core::hresult ExecuteCommand(const string & containerId,const string & options,const string & command,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Executes a command inside the specified container.

methods.description: Adds annotations to a container.

methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.description: Mounts a source to a target inside the container.

methods.name: Core::hresult Unmount(const string & containerId,const string & target,bool & success,string & errorReason)
methods.description: Unmounts a target path inside the container.
